# Sirach Chapter 49 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Codex Vaticanus, Sirach 49 | **Date:** 2026-03-17

---

**49:1** The memory of Josiah is like a blending of incense skillfully prepared; in every mouth it is as sweet as honey, and like music at a banquet of wine.

**49:2** He did what was right in the conversion of the people and took away the abominations of iniquity.

**49:3** He set his heart upon the Lord; in days of lawlessness he upheld piety.

**49:4** Apart from David, Hezekiah, and Josiah, all were gravely at fault, for they forsook the law of the Most High — the kings of Judah came to ruin at the end.

**49:5** So they handed over their power to others and their glory to a foreign nation,

**49:6** who burned the chosen city of the sanctuary and made its streets desolate — as Jeremiah had foretold.

**49:7** For they had mistreated him, though he was consecrated in the womb as a prophet, to pull up and tear down and destroy, and equally to build and to plant.

**49:8** It was Ezekiel who saw the vision of glory, which God showed him above the chariot of the cherubim.

**49:9** For he also referred to Job, who maintained all the paths of righteousness.

**49:10** And may the bones of the twelve prophets spring up fresh from where they lie! For they comforted the people of Jacob and delivered them with confident hope.

**49:11** How are we to extol Zerubbabel? He too was like a signet ring on the right hand.

**49:12** And Jeshua son of Jozadak as well; who in their day built the house of the Lord and raised up the holy temple, destined for everlasting glory.

**49:13** The memory of Nehemiah also is great; he rebuilt for us the fallen walls and set up gates and bars and restored our ruined houses.

**49:14** No one like Enoch has ever been born on earth, for he was taken up from the earth.

**49:15** And no one like Joseph, either, who was born a man; and his body was watched over.

**49:16** Shem and Seth were held in honor among men, but above every living being in the creation was Adam.
